implementation.frame: Validate before handle mutation and notification; consume generation once; recheck after change to reject reentrant old continuation.

implementation.disposed: start/reset reject after unmount; old RAF cannot notify.
implementation.tokens: No CSS token or public API additions; reduced visual motion must not change business timing.
